lines: Lee County is located in north central Illinois. Our rural setting includes the beautiful Rock River valley, bountiful fields of agriculture, industry, and peaceful hometowns. Members of the Lee County Democrats are as diverse in experiences as our county’s varied resources. But, we are unified in our values. Opportunity and equal rights for all citizens are the cornerstone of Democratic beliefs.

The Lee County Democratic Party is the party of the people. We are committed to preserving the Democratic Party’s principles that support the freedoms and rights of all American citizens with zero tolerance for exclusion or discrimination. We welcome Lee County residents of every race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, economic status, and condition. We are the Party of working families, and we are committed to working together on behalf of Lee County’s working class.
To support and promote the growth and development of the Democratic Party and its principles.
To actively seek and support Democratic candidates for public office, including candidates for nonpartisan offices.
To inform voters of relevant issues and candidates’ positions on those issues.
To perform such election functions as required by law.
To raise funds for the above purposes.

The Get Out the Vote/Party Building Committee meets once a month to work on content for the newsletter, the website, and to generate ideas for growing our membership and volunteer base. We invite all who are interested to join our meetings or to share ideas with committee members. Like so many things, our activities have been limited due to the pandemic but we look forward to a time when we can begin to plan in person gatherings. Volunteers are critical to the success of the Lee County Democratic Party organization. We hope you will find an activity in the Party for your special skills and talents.

The Fundraising Committee plans and organizes all fundraising events. Funds are used to support the candidates, pay for an office during election seasons, and promote future fundraising efforts. The results of our efforts are especially rewarding when Democratic candidates and values are promoted throughout the county.
To help with fundraising, you can take part in a fundraising event, join the committee or donate!

Our nation is at a turning point and it starts right here at home. For too long, conservatives have watched our values and freedoms challenged by those who want to rewrite the very foundation of America. The time for sitting on the sidelines is over. It’s time to stand up, speak out, and reignite the Republican fight in Lee County.
We are calling on every patriot, every family, and every neighbor who believes in limited government, individual liberty, and faith in our Creator to get involved.
Together, we can restore conservative leadership in Lee County and keep Illinois rooted in the principles that made this nation great.
Let’s stand united. Let’s get to work. Let’s reignite the Republican fight.
Step Up as a Precinct Committeeperson
Becoming a Precinct Committeeperson is one of the most powerful ways you can make a difference. You’ll have the opportunity to:
Shape the direction of the party right here in Lee County
We’ll guide you through every step from circulating a petition to getting your name on the ballot. It’s easier than you think, and your involvement matters more than ever.
Every dollar helps us reach more voters, promote our message, and elect Republicans who will fight for our values. Please consider making a donation today through our secure WinRed page:
Or if you prefer, you can still mail your contribution to
Lee County Republican Central Committee P.O. Box 223 Dixon IL 61021
Every bit counts, and we are deeply grateful for your support.

The objective I propose is quite simple to state: to foster the infrastructure of democracy - the system of a free press, unions, political parties, universities - which allows a people to choose their own way to develop their own culture, to reconcile their own differences through peaceful means.
I have wondered at times what the Ten Commandments would have looked like if Moses had run them through the US Congress.
There are no easy answers, but there are simple answers. We must have the courage to do what we know is morally right.
Within the covers of the Bible are the answers for all the problems men face.
My philosophy of life is that if we make up our mind what we are going to make of our lives, then work hard toward that goal, we never lose - somehow we win out.
The most terrifying words in the English language are: I’m from the government and I’m here to help.

The average age of the world’s great civilizations has been 200 years. These nations have progressed through the following sequence: From bondage to spiritual faith ... from spiritual faith to courage ... form courage to liberty ... from liberty to abundance ... from abundance to selfishness ... from selfishness to complacency .... from complacency to apathy ... from apathy to dependency ... from dependency to back to bondage.

Of all the dispositions and habits which lead to political prosperity... religion and morality are indispensable supports. In vain would that man claim the tribute of patriotism who should labor to subvert these great pillars.
History is God’s providence in human affairs

lines: Lee County IL is looking for some strong conservative individuals with leadership qualities to campaign for elected offices in order to take the Republican message to every American, grow the party, promote election integrity, and elect Republicans up and down the ballot. The principles of the Republican Party recognize the God-given liberties while promoting opportunity for every American.
A Lee County Republican precinct committee person is a member of the Republican Party’s Central Committee and is responsible for voter education, engagement, and voter turnout within their precincts.

In addition to voter engagement, the Precinct Committee is responsible for candidate recommendation and slating. Candidate recommendations are needed when a seat, such as one on the county board, is vacated and the prior board-member was a Republican. The PCs from the county board district vote to recommend a replacement to the board chair. The chair is not obligated to follow that recommendation but is always encouraged.
